parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal law or documented visitor-facing facility/border ban; same-sex criminalisation repealed; an annual capital Pride and health-service non-discrimination on gender identity are modest positives. However the worst documented feature is repeated violence against trans people, especially trans women, with state police/parapolice among aggressors and official impunity; NGO counts show sexual assault, extortion, killings and unreported attacks over several years, and recourse is weak or absent. Resident family/employment gaps and old marriage-opinion data are secondary. This places the jurisdiction below elevated-risk, state-tolerated targeting, but above severe-risk because discovery is not a near-automatic imprisonment/execution policy or universal inescapable restriction.
